title: A Window Of Opportunity
summary:
Sanctions relief will change trade flows
On Wednesday, 18 October, the U.S. Treasury Department announced that it would ease sanctions against companies that trade in Venezuelan oil or invest in the country. Sanctions on exports of crude oil, refined petroleum products as well as gold will be lifted for six months.
